description: Source code implementing JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations in the WPEFramework plugin, including methods for setting, getting, deleting keys/namespaces, and managing storage limits.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations, including key-value management, namespace handling, cache flushing, and storage limits.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the persistent store with optional TTL.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value and TTL for a given key.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specified key from the store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage sizes per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
